metadata.syllabus_name: Multiplatform Mobile App Development_Phát triển ứng dụng di động đa nền tảng
metadata.time_allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h TE + 85' PE + 103.6h self-study
metadata.description: This course helps learners master the knowledge of React Native. Learners can quickly develop mobile applications running on iOS and Android platforms. Contents to be implemented include:- Overview of React Native and its benefits.- Setting up the development environment.- Understanding components and navigation.- Hands-on experience with iOS simulator and Android emulators- Techniques for styling applications.- State management strategies using hooks and Redux.- Managing user input and touch events.- Using FlatList and SectionList for data presentation.- Mobile Notifications: Learn to integrate personalized notifications to enhance user engagement.- Databases: Explore using SQLite, Firebase for data management.- Debugging techniques and tools.- Publishing applications using Expo.- Integrate mobile app with Gemini AI
metadata.student_tasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.- Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time- Promptly access to the https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information
metadata.tools: - Visual Studio Code (https://code.visualstudio.com)- Internet- ChatGPT (https://chatgpt.com)- Gemini (https://gemini.google.com/app)- V0 by Vercel (https://v0.dev)

materials.description: React Native: Developing Android and iOS Apps

clos.lo_details: Understand what React Native is and how it can be used
Be able to integrated Gemini AI and Apply GenAI in solving problem
Be able to integrated Firebase services (FCM, Realtime database,...)
Understand how to push notification in React Native apps
Understand how to publish an application
Be able to build the React-native Application
Be able to understand the Components used for Mobile development
Understand how to style for React Native apps
Be able to manage state using hooks and Redux
Be able to using list in react-native for data presentation
Be able to use Debugging and Developer's Tools
Understand how to Modeling and Storing data

schedule.student_tasks: Listen actively, understand course structure, objectives, grading, and expectations. Ask clarifying questions.

schedule.topic: Introduction to React Native- What is React Native- Features and Use Cases of React Native - React Native architecture
schedule.student_tasks: Understand core concepts, features, pros/cons of React Native. Take notes. Ask questions.

schedule.topic: Setting up the React Native Development Ecosystem- Common Dependencies- Node.js Installation- Android Studio Setup- Android SDK Configuration- Environment Variables: Set up the ANDROID_HOME environment
schedule.student_tasks: Follow instructions to install Node.js, Watchman, IDE extensions, Expo CLI dependencies. Troubleshoot setup issues with guidance.

schedule.topic: Setting up the React Native Development Ecosystem (Cont)- Expo and Its Features- Install Expo Go on your device- Expo CLI- Setting up the Environment using Expo Snack
schedule.student_tasks: Complete Expo setup. Create a new project using Expo CLI. Run the basic app on a device or simulator.

schedule.topic: Emulator and Simulator Basics in React Native Development- Understanding Android SDK Emulator - Android SDK Emulator- Working with Android Emulator using Android Studio- iOS Simulator- Configuring iOS Simulator
schedule.student_tasks: Set up and configure an Android Emulator (AVD) and/or iOS Simulator. Practice running their app on these virtual devices.

schedule.topic: - Navigating the project structure in React Native using Expo commands- Compare Expo CLI versus React Native CLI
schedule.student_tasks: Explore the folders and files in a standard Expo/React Native project. Understand the purpose of key files (App.js, package.json, assets, etc.).

schedule.topic: Introduction to Virtual DOM in React Native
schedule.student_tasks: Understand the concept of the Virtual DOM and how it contributes to React Native's performance. Compare briefly with the web DOM.

schedule.topic: Introduction to Basic Components- View- Text- Image- Button- Text Input- Scroll View- Flat List
schedule.student_tasks: Learn the syntax and basic props for View, Text, Image, Button, TextInput. Practice using these components to build a simple static screen layout.

schedule.topic: Introduction to React Navigation ComponentsImplementation of Stack, Drawer, and Tab Navigation
schedule.student_tasks: Implement basic stack navigation between two or more screens using react-navigation. Understand navigator setup.
Learn how to create and apply styles using StyleSheet.createPractice styling basic components (color, font size, margins, padding)
Practice using Flexbox properties (flexDirection, justifyContent, alignItems, flex, etc.) to create responsive layouts. Complete layout exercises.
Understand the concept of CSS-in-JS with Styled Components. Practice defining and using styled components. (Optional: Refactor previous styles).

schedule.topic: Managing State with useState and useReducer
schedule.student_tasks: Practice using useState for simple state variables and useReducer for more complex state logic within components. Implement examples like counters or simple forms.

schedule.topic: Using Context API for State Management
schedule.student_tasks: Implement state sharing between components using the Context API. Understand createContext, Provider, and useContext.
Understand the core Redux concepts (actions, reducers, store, dispatch). Practice connecting a component to the Redux store (if guided).
Build a form with TextInput fields. Implement controlled components by managing input state using useState. Handle form submission.

schedule.topic: Validating Forms with Formik and Yup
schedule.student_tasks: Integrate Formik to manage form state and Yup for validation rules in their practice form. Display validation errors.
Practice saving simple data (e.g., user preferences, a token) to AsyncStorage and retrieving it when the app restarts.
Practice rendering large lists of data efficiently using FlatList. Understand data, renderItem, keyExtractor. Implement a SectionList for grouped data.
Add pull-to-refresh functionality to a FlatList or ScrollView using RefreshControl. Trigger a data refresh action.
Implement infinite scrolling (load more data on reaching the end) on a FlatList using onEndReached prop.

schedule.student_tasks: Work actively on Assignment 1, applying concepts from sessions 1-21. Ask specific questions for clarification or help.

schedule.lo: CLO1, CLO2, CLO3, CLO4, CLO5, CLO6, CLO7, CLO9
schedule.student_tasks: Submit Assignment 1. Pay attention to the review, noting common mistakes or best practices. Understand the final project scope and start brainstorming. Ask questions about the project.

schedule.lo: CLO1, CLO2, CLO3, CLO4, CLO5, CLO6, CLO7, CLO9
schedule.student_tasks: Take the test

schedule.topic: Working with React DevTools - Inspecting Components- Using Context API
schedule.student_tasks: Practice using React DevTools to inspect component hierarchy, view/edit props and state in their own or example apps.

schedule.topic: Working with React DevTools (Cont)- Performance Profiling
schedule.student_tasks: Practice using the Profiler tab in React DevTools to identify rendering bottlenecks in simple scenarios.

schedule.topic: Handling Errors and Debugging - Importance of Error Handling- Common Error Types- Error Handling Techniques:
schedule.student_tasks: Learn common types of errors. Practice using console logs and the debugger (Chrome DevTools) for basic debugging. Understand Error Boundaries concept.

schedule.topic: Handling Errors and Debugging (Cont)- Debugging Tools
schedule.student_tasks: Practice setting breakpoints, inspecting variables, and stepping through code using the debugger.

schedule.topic: Creating Android APK FilesHandling Updates in React Native
schedule.student_tasks: Understand the process for creating a release build (APK/AAB). Learn the concept of Over-the-Air (OTA) updates.

schedule.topic: Mobile App Notifications, Databases, & Publishing Introduction
schedule.student_tasks: Gain a high-level understanding of push notifications, local vs. remote databases, and the app store submission process.

schedule.topic: Handling Notifications in Mobile AppsNotification Delivery Systems
schedule.student_tasks: Understand the flow of push notifications (client registration, server sending, client receiving). Learn about permissions.
Practice setting up a library (e.g., expo-notifications) to request permissions and potentially receive local or test push notifications.

schedule.topic: Embedded databases introduction- Local Storage- SQLite- Couchbase Lite- LevelDB- BerkeleyDBBest Practices for Developers
schedule.student_tasks: Understand use cases for local databases. Learn basic SQL concepts relevant to SQLite. Practice setting up expo-sqlite.

schedule.topic: CRUD Operations in Embedded Databases- Operations
schedule.student_tasks: Practice writing and executing SQL queries for Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations in SQLite

schedule.topic: CRUD Operations in Embedded Databases ( cont )- Practical Application
schedule.student_tasks: Apply CRUD operations to a practical example within their app (e.g., saving notes, user data locally). Handle asynchronous database operations.
Understand the difference between local and remote databases. Learn about common remote database types (SQL, NoSQL) and BaaS options.

schedule.topic: Connecting Mobile Apps to Remote Databases
schedule.student_tasks: Practice making API calls to retrieve data from a sample public API or a simple backend provided by the lecturer. Handle responses and errors.
Create a Firebase project. Understand the key services offered (Firestore/Realtime DB, Auth, etc.). Connect their React Native app to the Firebase project.
Explore the Firebase console. Practice basic data operations (adding/reading data) in Firestore or Realtime Database directly or through guided app integration.

schedule.topic: Creating Notifications in React Native with Firebase
schedule.student_tasks: Integrate Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) setup into their app. Practice receiving notifications sent via the Firebase console.

schedule.topic: Gemini AI integration- Get API key- Project configuration
schedule.student_tasks: Obtain a Gemini API key. Set up the necessary SDK/API call structure in their project. Configure the project securely.

schedule.topic: Gemini AI integration (cont)- AI Model selection - Make promt and processing result
schedule.student_tasks: Practice selecting an appropriate Gemini model. Formulate prompts and make API calls from the app. Display the AI-generated response.

schedule.topic: Map integration - Request permission- Access location API
schedule.student_tasks: Install react-native-maps. Request location permissions. Get the device's current location and display it on a map component with a marker.
Install expo-image-picker. Implement functionality to request permissions, open the device's image gallery or camera, and handle the selected image URI.
